verdict.rationale: Bolna documents a built-in call history view with performance metrics, recordings, transcripts and raw execution data. Its analytics tab adds call summaries and extractions, which give some outcome-style data without the founder building their own tooling. However, none of the cited docs name success rates, call durations or sentiment, or describe aggregate dashboards. Missing for 10: explicit success-rate and duration metrics, sentiment analysis, aggregate analytics dashboard documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see call analytics — success rates, durations, outcomes, sentiment — in dashboards without building my own

citations.quote: View performance metrics, listen to recordings, read transcripts, and access raw execution data for debugging and analysis.
